## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-3008. The clickhouse-2 pod is stuck in ContainerCreating because the Corvane storage array (cv-array-02) has reached its maximum 512 LUN mapping limit on the host group. The CSI driver cannot mount the persistent volume until the storage array administrator cleans up existing LUN mappings to free up capacity. The pod's volume is properly provisioned and bound—it's purely a storage infrastructure capacity issue that needs to be resolved on the array side.
